ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity to high-intensity pixels on the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetrical white patches at the base of the notch extending laterally; irregular vertical white streaks on the lower half of both lobes; predominantly dark pigmentation in the upper-central areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch; interior angle calculated at approximately 48 degrees; bounding-box depth represents roughly 15 percent of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Dense serration across the posterior boundary; frequency of approximately 12 distinct peaks per lobe; amplitude variations between 8 and 22 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe trajectory follows a convex curve from the notch that transitions to a concave sweep toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity circular pixel clusters concentrated on the distal margins and tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of calcareous-like markers at the distal tips; no visible amputations or major trauma.
